identity.name: Property in Nepal
identity.@comment:name: Application name used for identification.
identity.@comment:version: Published application version. The final counter tracks updates.
identity.@comment:applicationId: Unique identifier for the application. Used for internal tracking and management.
identity.@comment:poweredBy: Indicates the framework or platform powering the application.

color.@comment: Add up to three color families: primary, secondary, and tertiary.

modules.name: neup.analytics
modules.@comment:name: Analytics module for tracking user interactions and application performance.
modules.@comment:isRequired: Indicates if the module is mandatory for the application.
modules.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the analytics module.
modules.@comment:packages: List of packages required by the analytics module. Each package should include a name and version.

modules.name: neup.sites
modules.@comment:name: Sites module for managing and rendering web pages and assets.
modules.@comment:isRequired: Indicates if the module is mandatory for the application.
modules.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the sites module.

modules.name: neup.drive
modules.@comment:name: File storage module for handling file uploads and downloads.
modules.@comment:isRequired: Indicates if the module is mandatory for the application.
modules.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the file storage module.

relocation.@comment:from: Base URL generated by the application.
relocation.@comment:to: Replacement base path for rendered assets.

modules.name: notifications
modules.@comment:name: Notifications module for sending alerts and messages to users.
modules.@comment:isRequired: Indicates if the module is mandatory for the application.
modules.@comment:methods: Specifies the methods of notification delivery used in the application.
modules.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the notifications module.

modules.name: account
modules.@comment:name: Account module for managing user accounts and authentication.
modules.@comment:isRequired: Indicates if the module is mandatory for the application.
modules.@comment:accountSystem: Specifies the account system used for user authentication and management.
modules.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the account module.

modules.name: neup.estate
modules.@comment:name: Estate module for property and listing data access.
modules.@comment:isRequired: Indicates if the module is mandatory for the application.
modules.@comment:permissions: Specifies the permissions required by the estate module. Each permission should be a string representing the type of permission needed.
modules.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the estate module.

platforms.@comment:type: Specifies the platform type. Options include web, android, and ios.
platforms.@comment:exists: Indicates if the web platform is supported by the application.
platforms.@comment:domain: Domain at which web application will be hosted.
platforms.@comment:basepath: Base path for the web application. This is the root path from which the application will be served, dont define this if its hosted on a single subdomain or domain.
platforms.@comment:projectId: Unique identifier for the project within the web platform.
platforms.@comment:permissions: Specifies the permissions required by the web application. Each permission should be a string representing the type of permission needed.

platforms.@comment:type: Specifies the platform type. Options include web, android, and ios.
platforms.@comment:exists: Indicates if the Android platform is supported by the application.
platforms.@comment:packageName: The package name for the Android application.
platforms.@comment:permissions: Specifies the permissions required by the Android application. Each permission should be a string representing the type of permission needed.

platforms.@comment:type: Specifies the platform type. Options include web, android, and ios.
platforms.@comment:exists: Indicates if the iOS platform is supported by the application.
platforms.@comment:bundleIdentifier: The bundle identifier for the iOS application.
platforms.@comment:permissions: Specifies the permissions required by the iOS application. Each permission should be a string representing the type of permission needed.
